answer_1.quote: Automatic summarization is a challenging text generation task that condenses the source text into a few coherent and abstract sentences.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the generated summaries using lexical-overlap metrics, specifically ROUGE-1/2/L, and embedding-similarity metrics, specifically BERTSCORE.

answer_4.quote: Human studies are conducted as an overall quality assessment of human preferences. We use a 7-point Likert scale to ask annotators to evaluate four dimensions: Fluency, Coherence, Consistency, and Relevance (equivalent to macro demands in §2.2).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators set the element-aware summaries as the baseline (score 0) and score on a range of -3 to 3 relative to it.
